provenance.tools: python3 -I (standard library re/json/str.find and lxml.html) used only to list the positions of <ref, {{sfn/{{cite, 10./doi/PMID strings and HTML comments in the wikitext, to list <sup typeof~=mw:Extension/ref> ids with their data-mw attrs and <li id=cite_note-...> ids in render.html in document order, and to verify every quote with text[cp:cp+len(quote)]==quote; every label decided by reading the text. sha256sum for file hashes. The throwaway snippets (token lister, marker lister, per-article label tables) were kept as files in a temporary scratchpad folder outside the output directory while working and deleted at the end.
